branches.conclusion: KU/WFI authorizes individual research doctorates, but the formal faculty doctorate procedure does not identify an Operations degree or named specialty. A current WFI Operations chair participates in the multi-institution Graduate Program in Operations Management (GPOM), expressly an exchange/doctoral training framework, not a separate KU-awarded route. This named training lead does not establish each participating institution as a distinct Operations awarder; formal WFI award-field linkage remains unresolved.

The current KU faculty inventory and central list of six faculties with doctoral-degree authority were read. KU has no engineering faculty. Mathematics and Geography is the sole plausible technical doctoral faculty; no Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering titled faculty/department is named in the complete faculties inventory. Detailed Math doctoral fields were not established by the central inventory, so a formally named field remains possible but unverified.
